Trusted validation accuracy was 0.75763547, indicating a working pipeline with moderate predictive performance.", "metric": 0.75763547, "lower_is_better": false, "code_summary": "Preprocessing uses a leakage-safe FeatureEngineer fit only on training folds: ordinal mappings for time/age/income/education/expiration, frequency encodings for venue columns, coupon affinity and interaction features, plus one-hot encoding of nominal columns. Models are an ensemble of a PyTorch MLP (BN/ReLU/Dropout, label-smoothed BCE, AdamW with cosine warmup), CatBoost, and LightGBM, each with early stopping on an inner validation split. Validation uses stratified K-fold out-of-fold predictions with a weight grid search for ensemble blending, followed by final refitting on full training data and persisting all artifacts (feature engineer, models, label mapping, weights) for fresh-process prediction."}
